description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role


We are looking for a Principal Product Specialist to join our team. This is a Remote role, based in the USA, reporting to the Director, Product Specialist in the PM - Security AI department. Drive product strategy and cross-functional execution for a Principal-level area within Zscaler’s Security AI portfolio, shaping how enterprise customers securely adopt AI agents and agentic workflows. The role owns outcomes end-to-end: identifying the highest-leverage bets, aligning Engineering, Design, Security Research, and GTM on them, and shipping capabilities that measurably improve customer security posture.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Contribute to the multi-quarter strategy and roadmap for a Principal-level area of the Security AI portfolio, grounded in customer problems, market signal, and the evolving threat landscape
  • Lead cross-functional execution with Engineering, Design, Security Research, and GTM to ship differentiated capabilities on a predictable cadence, with clear success metrics tied to customer outcomes
  • Run structured discovery with enterprise customers, partners, and the field; translate qualitative insight and product telemetry into crisp requirements and measurable outcomes
  • Shape portfolio-level decisions: frame product bets, contribute to platform and architecture direction, and align adjacent PM teams around a coherent Security AI narrative
  • Drive clarity at every altitude—write sharp PRDs and launch narratives, brief executives and stakeholders, and represent the product to customers, analysts, and partners

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity, comfortably building the path as you walk it, and seeing dynamic environments as opportunities to create something meaningful.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, embraces a challenge culture with respectful candor, and continuously builds trust.
  • You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for both internal and external users, and anchoring all product decisions in solving real-world problems.
  • You are a pragmatic builder who is obsessed with iterating and shipping, happy to roll up your sleeves to balance technical excellence with rapid user value.
  • You champion simplicity by distilling complex problems and technical concepts into precise, clear, and actionable plans.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 5+ years of product experience, including at least one full cycle contributing on an enterprise-grade product from discovery through scaled launch
  • Proven track record shipping platform, developer-facing, or security products in environments that demand real technical depth
  • Working fluency in at least one of: AI/ML systems, cloud security architecture, and identity protocols—sufficient to hold technical depth with engineers and make informed trade-offs
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and executive communication; able to influence without authority and drive clarity in ambiguous, matrixed environments
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Familiarity with agentic systems or emerging AI/agent protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A), prior PM experience on AI or Workloads platform, data protection, or SASE/Zero Trust products
  • Experience partnering with security researchers or red teams; comfort reasoning about adversarial threat models against AI systems
  • Hands-on technical fluency—reads code, builds prototypes, or interprets API/telemetry data to accelerate decisions with engineering
